functions.main_character_policy: Elara the Silt-Sifter (Lead Scavenger) should care when the event supports Manipulates state_material_stockpile by hoarding rare debris to force scarcity.; Kaelen the Zoning Architect (Zoning Permit Officer) should care when the event supports Manipulates state_district_access by issuing permits to restrict water access.; Vane the Tide-Merchant (Waterfront Trade Liaison) should care when the event supports Manipulates state_confiscation_rate via bribery to protect trade routes.; Soren the Tribunal Clerk (Archive Vault Keeper) should care when the event supports Manipulates state_confiscation_rate by hiding evidence in the archives.; Jorin the Crane-Wrench (Guild Maintenance Lead) should care when the event supports Manipulates state_material_stockpile by sabotaging sorting cranes to slow down processing.; Mira the Tide-Watcher (Tribunal Bailiff) should care when the event supports Manipulates state_confiscation_rate by selectively enforcing seizure orders.; Bram the Permit-Broker (Zoning Office Fixer) should care when the event supports Manipulates state_district_access by selling forged zoning permits.; Hana the Archive-Rat (Vault Archivist) should care when the event supports Manipulates state_confiscation_rate by altering historical property records.; Kaelith the Tide-Weaver (Hydraulic Engineer) should care when the event supports Manipulates state_shoreline_depth by calibrating water flow to erode or build land; Silas the Seal-Breaker (Bureaucratic Forger) should care when the event supports Manipulates state_confiscation_rate by forging official seizure stamps; Mara the Mud-Lark (Scavenger Scout) should care when the event supports Manipulates state_material_stockpile by identifying high-value debris before the Guild; Oren the Zoning-Spy (Permit Auditor) should care when the event supports Manipulates state_district_access by auditing zoning permits for errors.

The Tribunal Chamber requires formal attire and silence during adjudication.
Salvaged items are state property until processed by the Reclamation Guild.
Waterfront access is a privilege granted by the Neighborhood Planning Board, not a right.

task_ledger.self_outcome: {self} checks the task ledger and reprioritizes obligations.

meeting_notice.target_outcome: {self} passes the meeting notice to {target}, drawing them into the issue.
